name: audiobookshelf-mcp
description: Browse libraries, search books, and control playback in Audiobookshelf.

tools.name: list_libraries
tools.description: List all audiobook and podcast libraries

tools.name: search_library
tools.description: Search a library for audiobooks or podcasts by title, author, or narrator

tools.name: list_library_items
tools.description: List items in a library with pagination

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Get detailed information about an audiobook or podcast by its item ID

tools.name: get_items_in_progress
tools.description: Get audiobooks and podcasts currently being listened to

tools.name: get_listening_stats
tools.description: Get your overall listening statistics including total time and daily breakdown

tools.name: get_listening_sessions
tools.description: Get your recent listening sessions with titles, dates, and durations

tools.name: get_media_progress
tools.description: Get your reading/listening progress for a specific audiobook or podcast episode

tools.name: list_series
tools.description: List all series in a library (opt-in via the browse toolset)

tools.name: get_series
tools.description: Get details of a series including its books (opt-in via the browse toolset)

tools.name: get_author
tools.description: Get details about an author including their books (opt-in via the browse toolset)

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: List collections in a library (opt-in via the browse toolset)

tools.name: get_chapters
tools.description: Get an audiobook's chapters, total duration and audio files. Times are in seconds. Files are listed for context only; they are rarely chapters. (opt-in via the chapters toolset)

tools.name: search_audible
tools.description: Search Audible for editions of an audiobook, closest runtime first. Pick the unabridged edition in the right language whose runtime matches the book. If none does, retry with another spelling of the author (Audible often uses initials) or another region. (opt-in via the chapters toolset)

tools.name: get_audible_chapters
tools.description: Get Audible's chapter list for an edition by ASIN and region. Times are in seconds. Compare with the book before saving: if runtimeSeconds differs from the book's duration, or the chapters sit a constant few seconds off the book's own (often brandIntroSeconds), shift every start by that offset before set_chapters. (opt-in via the chapters toolset)

tools.name: set_chapters
tools.description: Replace ALL chapters of an audiobook. Show the user the complete list and get their confirmation before calling. Returns the previous chapters; to undo, call again with them. (opt-in via the chapters toolset)

tools.name: rename_chapters
tools.description: Rename an audiobook's chapters, keeping every timestamp. Pass one title per existing chapter, in order. Show the user the new titles and get their confirmation before calling. (opt-in via the chapters toolset)

audiobookshelf_url.title: Audiobookshelf URL
audiobookshelf_url.description: Base URL of your Audiobookshelf instance (e.g. https://audiobooks.example.com)

audiobookshelf_token.title: API Token
audiobookshelf_token.description: API token from Audiobookshelf Settings → API Keys

audiobookshelf_toolsets.title: Toolsets
audiobookshelf_toolsets.description: Comma-separated toolsets to enable: libraries, items, playback, browse, chapters, or all
